notes.title: HotSeat 2.0 Update!
Update 5 - Screen resolution fix
notes.content: The problem with the incorrect display resolution was fixed. In full screen mode, the screen of the game was displayed incorrectly on screens with an aspect ratio different from 16 to 9.

notes.title: Update 4 - More challenge in Fly mode
notes.content:
Fix List:
- Added Random Spawn of peas in Fly Mode
- Rebalanced Fly Mode
- Added detailed tutorial in main game mode
- Small changes in Main Menu
- Fixed some small bugs
